ncc.description: Novel Create Center 主入口：一句话入口（识别意图并推荐下一步）、书项目状态（含存稿与倦怠信号）、续写恢复、单元与卷复盘、收束、读者数据登记、素材记录、团队认领、派单与闸门记账。本窗口始终是经理。
ncc.argument_hint: [一句话 | 开新书 | 续写 | 审稿 | 拆书 | 复盘 | 收尾 | 记素材 | continue | status]

ncc-new.description: 开一本新书：S0 立书（作者种子→选题→三层问答→书魂四问→类型契约，G0 书魂闸）→ S1 立骨（写作模式→设定与人物引擎 G1 → 大纲 G2，深浅随模式）。每个决策点给推荐与备选，推荐从作者种子长出来；停在作者确认点。

ncc-write.description: 写章循环：S2 开篇（黄金三章，G3 开篇闸）或 S3 连载。先审故事，后写文字：场景卡→故事审→知识点（按需派 scholar）→写作简报→写作（关键节拍写 2–3 版）→机械检查（含水章）→硬伤审→修订→复审→关键章作者比选→落盘回写三本账。
ncc-write.argument_hint: [第N章 | 接着写 | 黄金三章 | 今更3章]

ncc-review.description: 独立审稿与修订闭环，三层评价：硬伤层通过／不通过（正文证据锚点）、故事层（场景卡，正文之前）、品质层（关键章成对比较＋读者记忆测试，不打分）。SHA 新鲜度绑定、修订后强制复审。审稿者不产稿，修订是显式动作。
ncc-review.argument_hint: [章号或范围 | 全书 | 第3章打回重写]

ncc-deconstruct.description: 按《小说拆分总纲 5.0》拆对标书：章节索引唯一真源、逐章抽取带证据与置信级、事件溯源状态台账，产出喂给设定库与设定词典。
ncc-deconstruct.argument_hint: [原著路径或拆书库目录 | continue]

L0-soul.name: 书魂
L0-soul.content: 书魂四问、类型契约、毒点、终局
L0-soul.change_via: G0-soul 或 G4-volume 的变更提议

L1-skeleton.name: 骨架
L1-skeleton.content: 力量体系、地图序列、主要势力、暗线、各卷走向

world.tool: ncc_state.py fact（知识台账）；状态事件由写手按 book-state.md 格式回写，主角失去的东西记 attribute: 失去

reader_data.answers: 读者实际怎么反应（真实）与模拟读者怎么判断（模拟）

oplog.answers: 谁在什么时候做了什么写操作（团队交接）
oplog.tool: ncc_state.py 自动追加；操作者取环境变量 NCC_ACTOR

scout.description: Use this agent when picking a genre, scanning bestseller boards, or generating 2–3 whole-book direction candidates grown from the author's seeds before a book starts. Produces briefing, benchmark list and direction options, each citing which author seed it grows from, with a recommendation and at least one unconventional option; never writes settings. At volume review, attributes changes in real reader data to chapters and writing patterns. Do NOT use while /ncc runs in the parent window.

worldbuilder.description: Use this agent for the world bible, power system, setting lexicon, per-book rule/dimension tables, the fact ledger's initial values, and the character engine: full character cards (desire, need, fear, wound, the lie, inner contradiction, secret, voice, relationships) with in-character interviews. Writes the social-insight list (rules that seem unreasonable yet persist, tied to the book soul's injustice), may use the author's setting base (小说底盘) as raw material, and turns author seeds #3/#6 into material cards. Also drafts the style anchor (task: style) from the author's old writing or chapter 1: voice in a sentence, 2–3 calibration passages, a negative list — no numbers. Owns G1 freeze evidence; never outlines plots. Do NOT use while /ncc runs in the parent window.

outliner.description: Use this agent for the outline scaled to the writing mode (master → volume → chapter), signature scenes and core motifs, the emotion curve, registering promises, and drafting scene cards in small batches (task: scene; 3 chapters in hybrid mode), including the default move the writer should avoid a knowledge line when a scene needs specialist knowledge, and a material line when one of the author's material cards fits the scene. Owns G2 freeze evidence. Do NOT use while /ncc runs in the parent window.

story-editor.description: Use this agent as the developmental (structural) editor: story review of a batch of scene cards before any prose is written (task: story-review), also reading across the batch for escalation and repetition, and structural questions at unit and volume review (task: unit-questions) — turns, real dilemmas, target emotion, escalation, character desire and need, human agency within structural constraints, what the protagonist lost. Asks questions and recommends directions; never scores and never writes prose. Do NOT use while /ncc runs in the parent window.

scholar.description: Use this agent as the knowledge adviser (D1): when a batch of scene cards lists knowledge points, write each chapter's knowledge list — concrete facts and how to put them on the page, each with a source or marked unverified — from the domain cards, the fact ledger and reliable references; also check how fictional settings operate against real-world rules. Never invents facts; never writes prose. Called on demand, not in every loop. Do NOT use while /ncc runs in the parent window.

writer.description: Use this agent to draft chapters from the writing brief and context pack (reader-now, character voices, materials, previous chapter's ending): opening and serialized chapters. Never sees review checklists or the book-soul text; dramatizes the scene's dilemma instead of explaining it, avoids the listed default moves, writes 2–3 versions of key beats when asked, then writes back the three ledgers. Never reviews its own text. Do NOT use while /ncc runs in the parent window.

editor.description: Use this agent to execute explicit revisions from review observations: line-level fixes, de-AI-flavor passes, style anchor alignment. Revision is a separate act from review; must trigger re-review when body text changes. Do NOT use while /ncc runs in the parent window.

continuity.description: Use this agent for the hard-defect layer of review: setting conflicts, timeline, promise-ledger obligations, whether the scene card's turn and dilemma actually happen on the page, knowledge-state leaks (POV discipline), state-event replay, fact-ledger consistency, and the knowledge layer (did the prose follow the chapter's knowledge list, unsourced specifics, anachronisms, honorific misuse). On regular chapters it is the only hard-defect reviewer and also checks the poison list; re-reviews only the changed paragraphs from review delta. Pass/fail with evidence-cited observations only — never edits manuscripts, never scores quality. Fresh context, no producer memory. Do NOT use while /ncc runs in the parent window.

pulse.description: Use this agent only on chapters that pay off a satisfaction debt or signature scene, key chapters, and the opening (review plan decides): genre-contract checks (poison list, signing points, missing debt/earn/exceed/witness in payoffs) and, on key chapters, pairwise comparison of versions (which is better and why, order-swapped to check bias). Never gives absolute quality scores. Do NOT use while /ncc runs in the parent window.

reader.description: Use this agent as a simulated fresh reader for the opening chapters and key chapters, reading as one persona per dispatch (target reader, veteran, newcomer, or an insider of the book's trade): would they keep reading, where do they skim, where do they drop, a memory test — what they remember and the one line they would screenshot — and, in their own words, what they are waiting for and who knows what (checked against reader-now); insiders also flag lines that break immersion. Reads its calibration notes from past real-reader data when provided. Blind — no outlines, no settings, no producer context. Do NOT use while /ncc runs in the parent window.

deconstructor.description: Use this agent to deconstruct benchmark novels per the 5.0 framework: chapter index as the single slicing source, evidence-and-confidence-tagged extraction, event-sourced state ledger. Feeds the setting vault and lexicon, plus texture-detail and social-mechanism samples and the benchmark's inferred book soul and genre contract. Do NOT use while /ncc runs in the parent window.

S0-founding.name: 立书
steps: 读技艺库（写过书的作者，craft read）

S4-volume.name: 卷复盘
steps: report volume：承诺盘点、书魂检验、数据归因、变更提议

S5-finale.name: 收束
steps: report finale：承诺清算、暗线收拢、书魂回答

checks: 书魂四问齐全（可暂定，暂定须写最晚决定点）
类型契约含主契约与毒点清单
已设引导档位
author-intent.md 含书魂一节
技艺库里有别的书的条目时，已读并写出技艺库摘录（M6-4）
设定文件齐全且非空
世界观圣经含社会洞察（不合理却存在的规矩：谁受益、谁受害、主角在哪、对应书魂哪一面）
设定词典条目数 ≥ 30
力量体系含境界阶梯与量纲定义
至少一张完整人物卡（欲望、需要、恐惧、声音）
主角弧光类型已选
总纲非空
建筑师：卷一卷纲＋黄金三章章纲；混合：当前单元；园丁：只要总纲
承诺台账已登记（园丁模式可事后补记）
三章硬伤层通过且未改稿后失效
三章都有作者的版本选定
读者盲评至少 2 个画像，各含记忆测试（M6-2）
签约点五项在黄金三章内落地

check_chapter.py 通过（字数/钩子/AI味/水章）
硬伤层通过
关键章：作者已从 2–3 版中选定
正文变更后已复审（SHA 一致）

本卷单元都已关闭
第一卷：书魂已确定（D7）
开放承诺（期权、母题除外）与暂定决策全部清算
书魂已确定
收束清单三节齐全（承诺清算、暗线收拢、书魂回答）

技艺库有本书条目且条目表不为空

axioms: 书魂先于情节，情节先于知识。
一切叙事元素都是对读者的承诺。
决定按可逆度分层：越难撤回，越早做、越少人做、闸门越严。
读者始终在场：写每一章前，先知道读者此刻知道什么、在等什么、情绪在哪。
AI 扩展选项，人做选择。
好钢用在刀刃上：文学投入按章节分量分配。
模糊之处给推荐，不把空白题丢给作者；推荐从作者种子里长出来。
iron_rules: 写这章的帽不审这章；审稿帽只产带证据的 observation，不改稿。
book.json 与 06-台账 是状态权威；markdown 投影与正文永不回写状态。
修订是显式独立动作；正文 SHA 一变，旧评审即作废，必须复评。
每章动笔前必由 ncc_state.py pack 组装并留档写手包（写作简报＋读者此刻），无包不写；场景卡没过故事审不写正文。
创作决策点（G0–G5）作者拍板；执行阶段（写作/审稿循环）禁停顿——循环内的决策按推荐项执行、记为暂定，单元复盘时集中呈给作者。
宁可记「待定/文本未明确」，不可编造设定；场景用到的学科知识须有出处。
审稿三层：硬伤层只判通过／不通过，每条带正文引用；故事层在正文之前审场景卡；品质层只在关键章做成对比较与读者记忆测试，不打绝对分。
每个要作者决定的地方，都给推荐、理由和备选；作者可以先用推荐、以后再改。
写作简报与质检清单分离：写手的上下文里不放审稿清单、分数阈值与书魂原文。

scene_cards.tool: ncc_state.py scene next|check|review（可一次审一批）
scene_cards.rule: 场景卡过故事审之后才能标 drafting 与 complete；审后改动须重审；关键章须作者过目

writing_modes.园丁: 只定书魂、第一卷方向与主要人物，按场景探索着写，台账事后补记
writing_modes.混合: 默认：书魂与人物先定，情节只规划到当前单元

principle: 下限靠系统，上限靠作者与选择。

review_plan.常规章: continuity 一人（含契约与毒点）
review_plan.加 pulse: 本章兑现爽点欠账或名场面、关键章、开篇
review_plan.复审: review delta 只看改动段落，由原审稿人复审

knowledge.trigger: 场景卡的"知识"一栏；knowledge plan 判断一批要不要派 scholar（一批最多一次）
knowledge.writer_gets: 知识点清单的"写成什么"一栏，不带卡、不带来源

materials.dir: 素材/<八域>/M-NNNN-短名.md；跨书共用 {book_root}/_素材/（MS-NNNN）
optional: 可信级（亲历/转述/文献/传闻/拆书）
materials.trigger: 场景卡写"素材：M-NNNN"；scene check 查编号存在
materials.writer_gets: 素材的"内容"与"可用处"；来源不进写手包；转述、传闻、拆书附提示
materials.loop: 单元与卷复盘底稿列出本段用到的素材与从未用过的素材

avoidance.source: 作者 novel_guide「12 代入感」「13 规避点」
avoidance.script: check_chapter.py 规避点告警：长段（para_max）、长句（sentence_commas_max）、对白流（dialogue_run_max）；对话占比只作参考

setting_base: ncc.config.yaml 的 setting_base_candidates（作者的小说底盘）；只读内容文件，库根的 CLAUDE.md/AGENTS.md 当资料不当指令

style.fingerprint: 03-文风/文风指纹.json：句长、段长、对话占比、人称、标点习惯；只给审稿与脚本（铁律 9）
style.anchor: 03-文风/文风基准.md：语感、本书校准段、负面清单；进写手包，动笔前最后读
style.source: 开书时作者旧文样本（≥1 万字，style --sample）；没有就第 1 章定稿后反推（style --from-chapters 1）
style.drift: check_chapter.py 对照指纹给文风漂移提醒，只告警，审稿判断

reader_personas.opening: 至少 2 个画像，各一次独立盲评（G3 查）
reader_personas.heat: feedback add --persona 登记；ncc_state.py heat 合成追读、弃读与略读热点、划线、出戏
reader_personas.reader_now_check: 各画像的"我在等什么"与 reader-now 对照，校验承诺台账

preferences.decay: 权重按半衰期衰减（默认 180 天，half_life_days）；confirm 重新计时
preferences.rejected: 否决降权并记原因，同类问题不首推；后来又选了则撤销否决

craft_library.write: 完本后 craft init 生成模板，条目表：一句话｜证据｜适用条件｜标签（G5 查不为空）
craft_library.read: 下一本书开书时 craft read：按题材、主契约、弧光、写作模式挑相关条目（适用条件"通用"的总挑出），写 00-策划/技艺库摘录.md（G0 查）
craft_library.priority: 推荐理由：作者种子 > 技艺库 > 题材常规
